## Complete endpoints for the ImageNet cohorts

The following tables show every method in the completed 50-epoch cohorts. Values are test mean-age MAE in years, reported as mean ± sample standard deviation across three joint blocks. The selected checkpoint minimizes clean-validation mean-age MAE; final means epoch 50. All comparisons use the retained reference test annotations.

### Original 78-fit intervention cohort

This cohort uses the original bfloat16 execution recipe. Its 13 methods share the paired encoder, subset, order, augmentation and supplied labels within each block.

### Float32 initialization and assignment controls

The first six rows belong to the 36-fit initialization cohort. The final row adds the six symmetric-assignment fits, with the ordered ordinary CE row supplying their matched reference. Heads and losses use float32 with bfloat16 encoders. The assignment follow-up uses two jobs per GPU and the initialization cohort uses eight; the design and figure captions record the execution scope.
